services.desc: The historic Esso Great Hall was constructed in 1885 and served as the financial headquarters for the Bank of Montreal. Ornate and regal, the Great Hall rises an impressive 45 feet high and is met by a 24-panelled, stained-glass dome, the largest of its kind in Toronto. Today, the Great Hall is home to the Stanley Cup, all the major NHL trophies, and plaques of every Honoured Member of the Hockey Hall of Fame. The Hockey Hall of Fame Concourse Level offers an exceptionably versatile event space that provides an entertaining and intimate journey into Canada’s primary passion. Guests can explore numerous exhibits, theatres, as well as immersive environments, including an interactive rink area
